bends.note: runs SSE from Hamer parallel to McMicken, then turns SE along the SW side of Grant Park to the Walnut/Moore junction
runs NNE-SSW (slope ~-1.37) from the Walnut junction, then curves to nearly N-S for the last block to Liberty
runs E-W from Walnut, then angles NE (perpendicular) to meet McMicken

notes: Vine is the west edge (west side is Volume 3: drawn only as a continuous boundary line broken at Liberty; the Elder pipe runs west to it, so Vine/Elder is marked cross for West Elder; Green Street on the west side is not shown and not guessed). Vine centre drifts from x~438 (top) to ~485 (Liberty). Benton (30', Vine to Hamer) and BENTON ALLEY (12', ENE from Hamer to McMicken) and BACK (SSE) all meet at the Hamer junction: Benton Street T at (1046,893), Back Street T at (1047,900), Benton Alley leaves Back's mouth at (1068,935). Hamer ends at Huber and Huber ends at Hamer (an L corner, recorded as T). Alleys between Vine and Hamer are printed THIRD, SECOND, FIRST, RUSS, FOLTZ and FLICK ALLEY (FIRST label has the block number 3 printed in it). The unnamed 12 ft alley from Back Street to McMicken at ~(1405,1463)-(1893,1157) is listed under alleys only. Walnut/McMicken/Moore/Back form an open plaza south of Grant Park: Moore and Back meet Walnut's centreline (x~2163, from its block lines 2055-2255 and pipe) at (2165,2312) and (2165,2358). North of the plaza Grant Park's east edge (x~2137-2163, shelter house 'WALNUT' frontage) lies on Walnut's centreline, so Walnut's roadway is only the wedge between the park and McMicken, which closes at the park's NE corner (2163,1764): Walnut merges into McMicken in an acute Y. Walnut/McMicken is recorded where Walnut's straight centreline meets McMicken's centreline, (2163,1580), north of the gore; uncertain (alternative: (2262,1722) if Walnut is taken as the wedge centre). McMicken is printed E. McMICKEN AV., 60' (66' near Main). Liberty is printed 40' near Vine and 33' near Main, but measures ~53 ft at Vine (pasted corrections). Moore/Liberty is a T: the Moore south of Liberty (sheet 151) is offset ~160 px (47 ft) east of this Moore. Main is only along the SE corner: its west line is x~3672 and its east line is off the paper, so Main/McMicken (its true centre ~ (3880,4240) judging from sheet 156) and Main/Liberty (centreline y~4600, below the paper edge ~4585) are not recorded. Scale ~3.4 px per ft.
